name: Mads Jørgensen
bio:
Mads Jørgensen's journey into the world of motorsport began unexpectedly. He initially pursued a culinary career, honing his skills in high-end restaurants across Copenhagen. A chance catering gig at a local racing event sparked a passion for the fast-paced, demanding environment of the track. Seeing the crucial role food plays in team performance, he shifted his focus to catering specifically for motorsport teams.

Joining 23XI Racing was a dream come true. Mads believes that a well-fed team is a winning team. He meticulously plans menus to optimize energy levels and nutritional intake, taking into account the specific needs of drivers and crew. He prides himself on his ability to adapt to the constantly changing schedules and logistical challenges of the racing circuit, ensuring that everyone has access to fresh, high-quality meals, no matter where they are. His reputation for delivering consistently excellent service and boosting team morale makes him a valued member of the organization.

Mads is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to create a sense of community within the team, even amidst the intense competition. He always tries to source local ingredients at each track, giving the team a taste of the local culture.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: A lean man of average height with a perpetual friendly smile.

quirks: Insists on brewing his own special blend of coffee every morning, even on race days.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and ingredient lists.
Whistles softly while preparing meals, often traditional Danish folk tunes.
